verdict.rationale: WooCommerce documents a public Store API for customer-facing product listing, search and filtering, cart building, and checkout, so an agent can shop through documented endpoints instead of scraping. It also claims native MCP support for AI tools, but the evidence does not show that the MCP surface is shopper-facing for product discovery and carts rather than store administration, and there is no UCP or agent-commerce protocol endpoint. Missing for 10: evidence that the MCP endpoint exposes shopper discovery and cart-building tools, UCP/agent-commerce protocol support, and hands-on or independent corroboration of agent shopping flows.
